title: Mahjong Tenshi: Angel Lips
native_title: 麻・雀・天・使 エンジェル・リップス
overview:
Voices and action both super-class! The definitive mahjong game.

Find the angel you like!

This adult strip mahjong game pits you one on one against three fully voiced women - Urara, Miyuki and Kanna - taken on in order. Win hands to make your opponent strip, then move on to the next challenger.

- 1 player
- Rated X: for ages 18 and over

声もアクションも超♥級！
麻雀ゲームの決定版

お好みの天使を見つけよう！
